name: PER_GENERATED_DATA_ROLES
description: This table stores the information related to data roles created on a Job Role.

columns.name: BUSINESS_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Identifier of Enterprise, used for multi-tenancy partitioning. Foreign key to HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS.

columns.name: BASE_ROLE_ID
columns.description: This field represents an internal ID for the job role inherited by a data role.

columns.name: DATA_ROLE_ID
columns.description: This field represents an internal ID for the role to which security profiles are assigned via the data roles UI.

columns.name: DATA_ROLE_NAME
columns.description: Internal name for the role to which security profiles are assigned via the data roles UI.

columns.name: DATA_ROLE_DISPLAY_NAME
columns.description: Display name for the role to which security profiles are assigned via the data roles UI.

columns.name: DATA_ROLE_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Role description of the role to which security profiles are assigned via the data roles UI.

columns.name: APP_ROLE_NAME
columns.description: Role name of an internal application role.

columns.name: APP_ROLE_DISPLAY_NAME
columns.description: Display name of an internal application role.

columns.name: APP_ROLE_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Role description of an internal application role.

columns.name: MODULE_ID
columns.description: Seed Data Framework: indicates the module that owns the row. A module is an entry in Application Taxonomy such as a Logical Business Area. When the MODULE_ID column exists and the owner of the row is not specified, then the Seed Data Framework will not extract the row as seed data.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
